### 5 Ways to Lead Your Kids to Jesus (Deuteronomy 11:19)
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-september-13.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:19
Points:
- Examine your own heart and apologize when needed so your actions do not stumble your children.
- Pray continually for your children's salvation and do not allow discouragement to stop you.
- Incorporate regular fasting alongside prayer when interceding for your family's spiritual breakthroughs.
- Model a genuine, spirit-led life by showing consistent kindness and grace in the home.
- Proactively expose your children to Christian truth and church community rather than leaving them unguarded.

### Educating Children - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/educating-children-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-5.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 11:18-19, 21
Points:
- Parents carry a God-given duty to commit themselves to Scripture and teach it to their children.
- Keeping God's word visually and mentally present aligns daily thoughts and deeds with His will.
- Daily routines—especially morning and evening hours—provide invaluable natural teaching moments.
- Wise instruction includes taking time to answer children's questions and correct misunderstandings.
- Faithfully instilling divine principles is designed to help children and families flourish long-term.
